protocol: features: WH trained by Adam on A=di_train of take 20, early stop on V=di_validation; frozen; readout = [x] + last-stage channels, 256-tap FIR each, constant, ridge 1e-4 relative, fitted on A of each take, read on B=di_test (48 kHz, SKIP 2400, floor 1e-4). Selection on V only.

scratch.source: session scratchpad capacity_split.json and run_a.json (outside the repository, copied to 4 decimals, not re-run here)

selection.criterion: min over (config, seed) of the mean readout capacity on V over the 5 H2 gain takes (30, 16, 20, 6, 7)

jvm.data: JVM410H OD1 PreampOut, ToneTwist, 44.1 kHz; A 0-150 s, B 215-300 s of the same input file (independence not established, no repeats)
jvm.train_split: 0-120 s fit, 120-150 s early stopping, of the centre G050

drive_bank.criterion: min mean readout capacity on V over the 5 gain takes

labels.difference_shares: chosen_B shares use features trained on take 20 and every one-knob pair has ref in (1, 20, 39): r_ref is a nonlinear fit, not a frozen reading; transfer.gain_pair_shares with clean=True are fully frozen readings
labels.take_20_1_39: features trained on A of take 20 (1 and 39 are its repeats, 1.4e-4 apart): a nonlinear fit to that take, not a frozen-probe reading
labels.upper_per_take: a model trained on A of the take itself: nonlinear in y, not a probe; its readout on its own features is not linear in y either
labels.multi_take: features trained on A of the 5 gain takes: those 5 and the repeats 1 and 39 of take 20 are not frozen-probe readings; the 35 other takes are
labels.by_gain_row_5: take 20 is the features' training take: its frozen_readout_* values are a nonlinear fit (the transfer matrix gives its frozen readings)
labels.jvm: A/B source independence not established, no repeats

fixed: multi-take label: takes 1 and 39 (repeats of take 20) are not frozen readings either
take-20 row of summary.by_gain flagged as a nonlinear fit
scratch numbers: provenance stated (outside the repository, not re-run)
docstring: the full model's B ratio of every run is computed and logged before selection (the selectors read V only)
declined: memo/Gram cache keyed by (length, sum, sum of squares): only the source sections A, V, B (and 2 JVM segments) reach it, their keys differ
stale chosen/upper blocks if the candidate grid changes: the grid did not change after selection; re-running `run` gave the same selection
review.disclosed: one human decision saw B: after wh3_s0 (V-best, full-model B logged), wh3 was kept at 3 seeds instead of being cut to 1; the V-selected run was already trained and did not change

5.note: take 20 is the features' training take: its frozen_readout_* values are a nonlinear fit (the transfer matrix gives its frozen readings)

multi_take_usable_frozen_only_B.takes: usable, without the 5 gain takes and 1, 39

transfer.note: features from take T read on take T are nonlinear fits, not frozen readings; take 20's frozen reading is the one from another take's features
